newsitem.title: FINLAND: AKTIA TO ISSUE FIM 40 MLN IN CORPORATE BONDS.
newsitem.headline: AKTIA TO ISSUE FIM 40 MLN IN CORPORATE BONDS.

text.p: Finnish savings bank and the central bank for independent savings banks Aktia Saastopankki Oy said on Tuesday it would issue a five-year 20 million markka debenture loan and a two-year 20 million markka bond.

The two instruments would be issued on February 13, and the subscription period for the five percent fixed coupon debenture bond would be February 13 to March 26 and for the 3.75 percent fixed coupon bond February 13 to March 14, Aktia said in a statement.
